{"metadata":{"description":"A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) client plugin that adds an "Execution graph" tab to the conversation view. It reconstructs one session turn's activity as a vertical timeline on a React Flow canvas","id":"gh:1353697837","install_available":true,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-plugin-execution-graph","slug":"liqiGeGe/dsh-plugin-execution-graph","topics":["dsh-plugin","dsh-plugins"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) client plugin that adds an "Execution graph" tab to the conversation view. "},{"id":"p1s2","text":"It reconstructs one session turn's activity as a vertical timeline on a React Flow canvas"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-plugin-execution-graph"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"English | 中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) client plugin that adds an **"Execution graph"** tab to the conversation vi"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"ew. It reconstructs one session turn's activity as a vertical timeline on a React Flow canvas: the t"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"urn's `request-header`, `assistant-message`, `tool-call`, and `tool-result` nodes are ranked into ti"},{"id":"p4s4","text":"meline steps stacked top-to-bottom and connected by arrowed edges from each step to the next. `turn-"},{"id":"p4s5","text":"group` container nodes are not drawn — one turn is shown at a time (defaulting to the session's last"},{"id":"p4s6","text":"), so a container box would be redundant. Tool calls are never merged by name — each call and its re"},{"id":"p4s7","text":"sult are independent nodes tied by a `resolves` edge, an assistant message's tool-call blocks connec"},{"id":"p4s8","text":"t to their `tool-call` nodes by a `triggers` edge, and same-group nodes chain by a `sequence` edge i"},{"id":"p4s9","text":"n event order. Parallel tool calls triggered by one assistant message share a timeline step and spre"},{"id":"p4s10","text":"ad horizontally; a column is capped at ten steps and then wraps into the next column block to the ri"},{"id":"p4s11","text":"ght, and the cross-column connectors keep React Flow's default curved edge shape — there is no right"},{"id":"p4s12","text":"-angle rerouting. A running tool call (present in the shared Session window's running-call-id set, w"},{"id":"p4s13","text":"rerouting. A running tool call (present in the shared Session window's running-call-id set, w [长行截断]"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## Compatibility"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"Install the plugin version that matches your DSH runtime. The package's
`peerDependencies` pin the c"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"lient APIs it was built against, so `dsh plugin`
rejects a mismatched pair instead of loading a plug"},{"id":"p6s3","text":"in built for another client
line."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"| DSH runtime | Plugin version | Status |"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"| `0.2.x` (client peers `^0.2.2-rc.1`) | `0.2.x` — tags `>= v0.2.0` | current |
| `0.1.x` (client pe"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"ers `^0.1.1-rc.2`) | `0.1.x` — tag `v0.1.4` | maintenance only |"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"A bare `dsh-plugin-execution-graph` install resolves to the registry's `latest`
tag, so pin the vers"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"ion explicitly (see Installation)."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"## What's changed in 0.2.x"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"- **Turn picker paging and history** — turns list newest first, ten rows per page with a pinned "loa"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"d more" row, and a "load earlier turns" row pulls one older session-history page when the loaded win"},{"id":"p11s3","text":"dow runs out.
- **Markdown detail** — assistant replies, user prompts, and request prompts render th"},{"id":"p11s4","text":"rough the same shared `MarkdownText` renderer the Trajectory preview uses; the detail header copies "},{"id":"p11s5","text":"the raw Markdown and confirms with a localized toast.
- **Complete assistant detail** — the reasonin"},{"id":"p11s6","text":"g stream and the triggered tool names are shown, with a placeholder when a reply has no text, reason"},{"id":"p11s7","text":"ing, or calls.
- **Default cross-column edges** — the right-angle merge-junction routing was removed"},{"id":"p11s8","text":"; wrapped columns connect with React Flow's default curves.
- **Canvas controls** — the minimum zoom"},{"id":"p11s9","text":" is `0.2`, and the scroll-to-top control targets the top-left node even when wrapped columns share t"},{"id":"p11s10","text":"he same row.
- **Stable chrome** — the toolbar is sticky, and the view is bound to the session viewp"},{"id":"p11s11","text":"ort height so opening a long detail keeps the canvas controls visible while the sidebar scrolls inte"},{"id":"p11s12","text":"ght so opening a long detail keeps the canvas controls visible while the sidebar scrolls internally."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"## Plugin results"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"## Plugin declaration and lifecycle"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"This is a pure-consumer Cordis plugin with two entry faces:"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"- **Node half** (`src/index.ts`) — a no-op `apply()`; the plugin has no host-side behavior.
- **Clie"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"nt half** (`src/client/index.ts`) — the real plugin. It exports `inject` and `apply(ctx)`, following"},{"id":"p15s3","text":" the DSH function-plugin contract (no default export)."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"`apply(ctx)` performs exactly these side effects, each registered reversibly through the Cordis effe"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"ct system so that unloading the plugin reverts them in full:"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"1. **Locale dictionary** — `ctx.effect(() => ctx.locale.register('graph', { zh, en }))`; unload de-r"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"egisters the `graph` namespace.
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"### Requirements"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"- A DSH runtime hosting the client web surface (the `dsh` CLI with a web-enabled profile) on the **0"},{"id":"p19s2","text":".2.x line**, paired with plugin `0.2.x` (see Compatibility) — i.e. the DSH core packages (`@deepseek"},{"id":"p19s3","text":"-ai/dsh-client-*`, `@deepseek-ai/dsh-*`) at `^0.2.2-rc.1` with `@deepseek-ai/cordis` at `^4.0.1`, ex"},{"id":"p19s4","text":"actly as declared in this package's `peerDependencies`.
- `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives` an"},{"id":"p19s5","text":"d `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-slots` are **not** peer dependencies: they are platform modules the DS"},{"id":"p19s6","text":"H host shares into its frozen module table, so the plugin's client bundle imports them as externals "},{"id":"p19s7","text":"resolved by the host.
- Node.js ≥ 22 and pnpm for a from-source checkout."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"## Extension points and compatibility"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"The plugin uses only official DSH extension points and never forks or patches core code:"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"- **Conversation Event Definitions** (`ctx.uiConversation.events`) and **Conversation View Definitio"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"n** (`ctx.uiConversation.views`) — the same two-tier fold/build pipeline Trajectory uses, to project"},{"id":"p22s3","text":" session events into a `GraphSnapshot`.
- **UI slot** — injects into the `'conversation.view'` slot "},{"id":"p22s4","text":"ring (id `graph`, order 20), alongside Chat and Trajectory.
- **Locale** — registers the `graph` dic"},{"id":"p22s5","text":"order 20), alongside Chat and Trajectory.
- **Locale** — registers the `graph` dictionary namespace."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"**Contract tests.** The package carries a client-bundle test that loads the built `lib/client.js` th"},{"id":"p23s2","text":"rough `window.__ModuleLoader__.load` and asserts the handoff id and the `apply`/`inject` exports, an"},{"id":"p23s3","text":"d a views test that mounts the plugin on a real `SlotRegistry` ring and asserts the tab appears. An "},{"id":"p23s4","text":"**unload test** disposes the fiber and asserts the view tab, the conversation-event registrations, a"},{"id":"p23s5","text":"nd the view-builder registrations are all removed."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"## Known Limitations and Deferred Work"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"- **Layout recomputes on every snapshot change** — the timeline is laid out from scratch on each ren"},{"id":"p25s2","text":"der rather than incrementally repositioning only new nodes, so very long sessions pay a growing layo"},{"id":"p25s3","text":"ut cost per update. No pagination or windowing exists yet; the view always renders the whole selecte"},{"id":"p25s4","text":"d turn.
- **Vendored React Flow base stylesheet** — the functional layout styles are copied to `src/"},{"id":"p25s5","text":"client/styles/reactflow-base.css` and injected as a plugin-owned `<style>` tag, because the client b"},{"id":"p25s6","text":"undler resolves `.css` imports relative to the importer and cannot take a bare `@xyflow/react/dist/b"},{"id":"p25s7","text":"ase.css` import. Bump the copy alongside the `@xyflow/react` dependency."}],"truncated":true}
